title: Kab se Bechain Hoo
body:
jab shaam ke zindan mein kohraam bapa
bain se bali sakina ke larazti hai fiza
sard hai saara badan zard hai gham se chehra
aah karti hai to hil jaata hai zindan saara
khwaab se chaunk ke uth baithi hai roti roti
apne seene se lagaye huye baithi hai phupi
roke kehti hai ke baba mere paas aaye thay
phupi amma wo yahin paas mere baithe thay
mujhse kehte thay mera dil nahi lagta beti
aaja ab aaja meri godh mein aaja beti
<<DIVIDER>>
kabse bechain hoo surat to dikhado mujhko
phupi amma mere baba se milado mujhko
<<DIVIDER>>
wo yahin honge kahin aap zara de to sada
kahiye unse meri jaanib se ke beti ho fida
door hi se zara awaaz sunado mujhko
kabse bechain hoo...
phupi amma mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
gham se phat jayega beti ka kaleja baba
baksh do mujhko agar ki ho koi maine khata
hoo sazawaar par itni na saza do mujhko
kabse bechain hoo...
phupi amma mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
shukr allah ka mushkil hui asaan meri
kat gaye qaid ke din aagayi ruqsat ki ghadi
ab safar khair se guzre ye dua do mujhko
kabse bechain hoo...
phupi amma mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai khushi ki ye ghadi aankh na kije purnam
aap ko deti hoo mai aun o mohamed ki qasam
muskurate hue jaane ki raza do mujhko
kabse bechain hoo...
phupi amma mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
bandh aankhein hui jaati hai meri dekhe zara
loriyan deti hai mujhko koi manoos sada
neendh aati hai phupi jaan sulado mujhko
kabse bechain hoo...
phupi amma mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
maangiye ab na duayein mere jeene ke liye
dekhiye aagaye baba mujhe lene ke liye
qibla rooh karke phupi jaan lita do mujhko
kabse bechain hoo...
phupi amma mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye taqdeer ke mar kar bhi rahi zindan mein
qabr bhi paayi to bachi ne wahin zindan mein
kya khata ki thi sakina ne batado mujhko
kabse bechain hoo...
phupi amma mere...
author: Sachey Bhai
